blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Mishandled checked baggage remains a recurrent issue in airport operations, and current recovery workflows still largely rely on tag-based tracking, which does not directly support visual identification when tag evidence is missing or unavailable.
This paper investigates baggage re-identification as an instance-level retrieval problem in a multi-camera setting, leveraging DINOv3 foundation-model representations to match a query image against a gallery of registered baggage images.
A Torchreid-style BNNeck re-identification head is placed on top of a DINOv3 backbone, and parameter-efficient adaptation is performed via LoRA. Experiments are conducted on the MVB benchmark using a progressive study that compares a fully frozen backbone against LoRA and fine-tuning strategies.
Results indicate that parameter-efficient adaptation of foundation-model features provides an effective and stable approach for multi-view baggage re-identification under limited training data.
blocks.zh:
在机场业务中,被误手的被检查行李仍然是一个经常出现的问题,目前的回收工作流程仍然在很大程度上依赖于基于标记的跟踪,在标记证据缺失或无法获得时,这种跟踪并不直接支持可视识别.
本文调查了行李在多相机环境下重新识别为实例级检索问题,利用DINOv3地基-模型表示,将查询图像与已登记的行李图像相匹配.
一个火炬式的BNNeck再识别头被放入DINov3主干上方,参数高效的适应通过LORA进行. 在MVB基准上进行实验时采用渐进式研究,将完全被冻结的骨干与LORA进行比较并进行微调策略.
结果表明,以参数效率调整基础模型特征,为在有限的培训数据下重新识别多视图行李提供了一个有效而稳定的方法。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Despite continuous improvements in airport operations, mishandled checked baggage remains a persistent operational and customer experience issue. Recent industry reporting estimates a global mishandling rate of 6.9 bags per 1,000 passengers in 2023 (down from 7.6 in 2022), with delayed bags accounting for the majority of cases (77%) and transfer-related issues representing a large fraction of delays (46%) [ 1 ] . Beyond passenger frustration, mishandling also translates into non-negligible operational costs: IATA (International Air Transport Association) estimates that reuniting passengers and baggage costs roughly $100 per bag [ 2 ] .
blocks.zh: 尽管机场业务不断改善,处理不当的检查行李仍然是一个持续的运作和客户经验问题。 最近的行业报告估计,2023年全球每1 000名乘客处理不当率为6.9袋(低于2022年的7.6袋),延迟处理的袋占大多数(77%),与转移有关的问题占延误的很大一部分(46%)[1]。 除了乘客的挫折之外,处理不当还导致不可忽略的业务费用:国际空运协会(空运协会)估计,旅客和行李的团聚费用约为每袋100美元。

blocks.en: In current airport workflows, baggage identification and tracking are predominantly tied to tag-based processes, where tracking evidence must be recorded at specific checkpoints. To standardize this process and reduce mishandling, IATA Resolution 753 requires tracking at four core points: Acceptance , Load , Transfer , and Arrival [ 2 ] . While such mechanisms provide essential traceability, they do not directly address scenarios in which a bag must be recognized from images (e.g., CCTV or operational cameras), or matched across cameras when tag evidence is missing, corrupted, or unavailable at the time of inspection.
blocks.zh: 在目前的机场工作流程中,行李识别和跟踪主要与基于标签的程序挂钩,在具体检查站必须记录跟踪证据。 为了使这一过程标准化并减少处理不当,空运协会第753号决议要求在四个核心点进行跟踪:接受、装入、转让和抵达。 [2]. 虽然这种机制提供了基本的可追踪性,但它们并不直接处理必须从图像(例如闭路电视或操作相机)中识别出袋的情景,也不直接处理在检查时标签证据丢失、被损坏或没有时相机相匹配的情景。

blocks.en: At the same time, the increasing adoption of self-service and automated check-in/bag-drop solutions creates an opportunity for visual registration under controlled conditions. In this setting, the standard identification step (tag assignment and record creation) can be complemented by capturing a small set of multi-view images of each bag in a stable environment (consistent viewpoint constraints, lighting, and background), thus producing a clean visual “signature” at registration time. Later, when the bag is observed in less constrained areas of the airport, the system can perform instance-level retrieval by matching a query image against a gallery of registered multi-view images to retrieve the corresponding bag identity (and hence its associated record).
blocks.zh: 与此同时,越来越多地采用自助和自动登入/包投式解决办法,为在控制条件下进行目视登记创造了机会。 在此情况下,标准识别步骤(tag assign and record creation)可以通过在稳定的环境中捕捉出每袋的一小组多视图图像(一致的视线限制、照明和背景)来补充,从而在注册时产生干净的视觉"签名". 后来,当在机场受限制较小的地区观察到包后,系统可以通过将查询图像与已注册多视图图像相匹配来进行实例级检索,以取回相应的包身份(并因此取回相关记录).

blocks.en: Baggage ReID is challenging because many baggage items share nearly identical global appearance due to industrial manufacturing, and the discriminative evidence is frequently confined to fine-grained instance-specific cues such as stickers, surface wear, or small damages. These cues may further be affected by viewpoint changes, occlusions, motion blur, illumination differences, and background clutter. This paper investigates baggage re-identification on the MVB benchmark using foundation-model visual representations, leveraging self-supervised transformer features for cross-view matching [ 3 ] .
blocks.zh: 由于工业制造,许多行李物品在全球的外观几乎完全相同,因此行李重新识别系统具有挑战性,歧视性证据往往仅限于贴具、表面磨损或轻微损害等细微的个案提示。 这些提示可能进一步受到观点变化、隐蔽、运动模糊、发光差异和背景模糊的影响。 本文调查了MVB基准上使用地基模型可视化表示的行李再识别,利用自控变压器的特性来进行交叉视野匹配[3].

blocks.en: Therefore, considering the need to improve current solutions, the paper proposes BagDINO as a foundation-model-based approach to baggage re-identification and makes the following three main contributions: • The development of a baggage re-identification pipeline (Figure 1 ) built on top of DINOv3 ViT-L/16 representations [ 4 ] and a Torchreid-style BNNeck head [ 5 ] , framing the task as instance-level retrieval in a multi-camera setting. • A LoRA-based parameter-efficient adaptation configuration [ 6 ] is evaluated by injecting low-rank updates into the backbone projections qkv , proj , fc1 , and fc2 , while keeping the original backbone weights frozen. • A progressive experimental study on MVB [ 3 ] compares a fully frozen backbone, LoRA adaptation, and partial/full fine-tuning under a shared training recipe, reporting performance in terms of mAP and CMC at Rank-1/5/10; across the tested configurations, results range from 0.57 mAP and 0.60 Rank-1 in the frozen setting to 0.88 mAP and 0.87 Rank-1 with LoRA (Rank-5/10: 0.96/0.98).
blocks.zh: 因此,考虑到需要改进目前的解决方案,该文件提议BagDINO作为行李重新鉴定的基础模式办法,并作出以下三个主要贡献: 开发由 DINov3 VIT-L/16 表示器顶部所建的行李再识别管(图1)和火炬式 BNNeck 头 [5],将任务设定为多相机环境下的例级检索. • 将低级更新注入骨干预测qkv、proj、fc1和fc2,同时使原骨干重量保持冻结,以此评估基于LORA的参数高效适应配置[6]。 二. 支助 关于MVB[3]的渐进实验研究比较了完全被冻结的骨干,LORA的适应,以及在共享培训食谱下的部分/完全微调,在Rank-1/5/10中报告了mAP和CMC的性能;在经过测试的配置中,结果从0.57 mAP和0.60 Rank-1在被冻结的环境下到0.88 mAP和0.87 Rank-1同LORA(Rank-5/10:0.96/0.98).

blocks.en: The development of a baggage re-identification pipeline (Figure 1 ) built on top of DINOv3 ViT-L/16 representations [ 4 ] and a Torchreid-style BNNeck head [ 5 ] , framing the task as instance-level retrieval in a multi-camera setting.
blocks.zh: 开发由 DINov3 VIT-L/16 表示器顶部所建的行李再识别管(图1)和火炬式 BNNeck 头 [5],将任务设定为多相机环境下的例级检索.

blocks.en: A LoRA-based parameter-efficient adaptation configuration [ 6 ] is evaluated by injecting low-rank updates into the backbone projections qkv , proj , fc1 , and fc2 , while keeping the original backbone weights frozen.
blocks.zh: 一个基于LORA的参数高效的适应配置[6]通过将低级更新注入骨干预测qkv,proj,fc1,和fc2,同时使原始骨干权重被冻结来进行评估.

blocks.en: A progressive experimental study on MVB [ 3 ] compares a fully frozen backbone, LoRA adaptation, and partial/full fine-tuning under a shared training recipe, reporting performance in terms of mAP and CMC at Rank-1/5/10; across the tested configurations, results range from 0.57 mAP and 0.60 Rank-1 in the frozen setting to 0.88 mAP and 0.87 Rank-1 with LoRA (Rank-5/10: 0.96/0.98).
blocks.zh: 关于MVB[3]的渐进实验研究比较了完全被冻结的骨干,LORA的适应,以及在共享培训食谱下的部分/完全微调,在Rank-1/5/10中报告了mAP和CMC的性能;在经过测试的配置中,结果从0.57 mAP和0.60 Rank-1在被冻结的环境下到0.88 mAP和0.87 Rank-1同LORA(Rank-5/10:0.96/0.98).

blocks.en: Fig. 1: Overview of the proposed baggage re-identification pipeline. A DINOv3 ViT backbone provides a global image representation (from the [CLS] token) and is adapted via LoRA modules injected into selected transformer projections (e.g., qkv , proj , fc1 , fc2 ) while keeping the pre-trained weights frozen. The resulting embedding is processed by a Torchreid-style BNNeck head and optimized with a composite objective that combines identity classification (cross-entropy with label smoothing) and batch-hard triplet loss. At inference time, the linear classifier is discarded and retrieval is performed using the normalized embeddings (e.g., cosine similarity) to rank gallery items for a given query.
blocks.zh: 发相. 1: 拟议行李再鉴定管道概述。 一个DINOv3 VIT主干线提供全局图像表现(取自[CLS]令牌),通过LORA模块被调整后注入到所选变压器预测(如qkv,proj,fc1,fc2)中去,同时保持被预先训练的重量被冻结. 所形成的嵌入由火炬式的BNNeck头处理并优化,其复合目标结合了身份分类(交叉-entropy与标签平滑)和批量硬三相失. 在推论时间,线性分类器被丢弃,并使用正态嵌入(例如同位素相似性)来进行检索,为给定查询排出画廊项目.

blocks.en:
The paper is structured as follows: Section II reviews the main research directions in baggage re-identification and related instance-retrieval approaches. Section III presents the proposed pipeline, including the DINOv3 backbone, the LoRA-based parameter-efficient adaptation strategy, the re-identification head, and the training objective. Section IV describes the experimental setup on the MVB benchmark and reports a comparative evaluation of different adaptation strategies together with an analysis of retrieval errors.
Finally, Section V concludes the paper and discusses possible directions for future research.
blocks.zh:
文件的结构如下: 第二节审查行李再鉴定的主要研究方向和相关的实例检索方法. 第三节介绍拟议的管道,包括DINOv3主干线、基于LORA的参数高效适应战略、重新确定负责人和培训目标。 第四节介绍了MVB基准的试验设置,并报告了对不同适应战略的比较评价以及对检索错误的分析。
最后一节 五. 完成本文件并讨论未来研究的可能方向。

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: Baggage re-identification has recently gained momentum as a practical instance-retrieval problem in airport logistics, largely driven by the introduction of the Multi-View Baggage (MVB) benchmark, a large-scale dataset with 4,519 identities and 22,660 images acquired in real multi-camera airport environments, which highlights domain shift between acquisition points and strong variations due to viewpoint, illumination, occlusions, blur, and background clutter [ 3 ] .Compared to person re-identification, baggage re-identification is inherently more challenging due to the high visual similarity across different baggage identities and the significant appearance variations within the same identity [ 7 ] .
blocks.zh: 行李重新识别最近成为机场物流中一个实际的个案检索问题, 主要是采用了多维行李基准, 与个人重新身份识别相比,行李重新身份识别在本质上更具挑战性,因为不同行李身份的视觉相似度较高,且同身份的外观相差很大 [7].

blocks.en:
In fact, early and “classical” pipelines on MVB typically adapt person/object ReID recipes with CNN backbones (e.g., ResNet-50) and metric learning (ID loss + triplet variants), and progressively enhance the baseline by injecting context and fine-grained cues. For example, Mazzeo et al. [ 8 ] propose an attention/multi-granularity strategy that combines global descriptors with local feature learning (e.g., masking/erasing-style mechanisms to force attention to discriminative regions) and global-context modeling, obtaining consistent gains over strong baselines by improving robustness to viewpoint changes.
Another influential direction is to explicitly model the multi-view nature of the problem at the loss/design level: QuadNet introduces a multi-view quadruplet loss to enforce cross-view compactness for the same identity while separating hard negatives both within and across views, and further strengthens discrimination with view-aware local features (e.g., CAM-guided regions), robustness-oriented augmentations (e.g., blur), and auxiliary supervision such as material prediction, reporting substantial improvements over conventional ReID baselines on MVB [ 9 ] .
blocks.zh:
事实上,MVB上的早期和“古典”管道通常采用CNN主干线(例如ResNet-50)和计量学习(ID损失+三重变体)来调整人/对象ReID配方,并通过注入上下文和精细的提示来逐步增强基线。 例如,马泽奥等. [8] 提出关注/多角度战略,将全球描述词与当地特征学习相结合(例如,掩盖/消除式机制,以迫使人们注意歧视性区域)和全球文字模型,通过提高从强基线角度看待变化的稳健性,获得一致的收益。
另一个有影响力的方向是在损失/设计层面明确模拟问题的多视角性质: QuadNet引入了多视图四面体损失,用于对同一身份实施交叉视图紧凑,同时区分观点内部和相互之间的硬反面,并进一步加强带有视界局部特征(如CAM导出区域)的歧视,强性导向增强(如模糊),以及辅助性监督,如材料预测,报告比MVB上常规ReID基线大有改进[9].

blocks.en: More recent works focus on improving cross-domain and cross-camera robustness and the final ranking stage; for instance, methods that combine domain-robust feature learning (e.g., normalization and attention modules), hard-sample mining, and camera-aware re-ranking (as in CDR-CARNet) show that carefully addressing domain shift and exploiting camera structure can markedly boost mAP and Rank-1 on MVB [ 10 ] .
blocks.zh: 更近期的作品侧重于提高跨域和跨相机的稳健性和最终排位阶段;例如,结合域-robust特征学习(如正常化和关注模块),硬样本开采和相机意识再排位的方法(如CDR-CARNet)表明,认真处理域位转移和利用相机结构可以显著地提升MVB上的mAP和Rank-1[10].

blocks.en: The Region-to-Global Vision Transformer (RGViT), the best reported SOTA in our survey, aggregates local evidence into regional tokens and explicitly models global spatial relations between regions, optimizing the embedding with a quadruplet objective designed for near-duplicate instances; in MVB it reports 88.7% Rank-1 and 89.6% mAP, suggesting that structured local-to-global modeling is particularly effective when many identities share highly similar global appearance [ 11 ] .
blocks.zh: 区域到全球愿景变换器(RGViT)是我们调查中报告得最好的SOTA(SOTA),它将当地证据汇总到区域标志中,并明确模拟区域之间的全球空间关系,优化嵌入方式,为近似重复的情况设计出四重目标;在MVB中,它报告了88.7%的Rank-1和89.6%的mAP,这表明当许多身份具有高度相似的全球外观时,结构化的地方到全球模型特别有效 [11].

blocks.en: Although recent methods have significantly improved performance on the MVB benchmark, most existing solutions still rely on adaptations of person re-identification pipelines originally designed for human appearance modeling. However, baggage objects present different visual characteristics compared to human subjects, including weaker structural priors, highly similar object categories, and frequent occlusions or deformations during handling. Consequently, approaches developed for person ReID may not fully exploit the discriminative cues specific to baggage identification.
blocks.zh: 虽然最近的方法在MVB基准上大大提高了性能,但大多数现有解决方案仍然依赖于最初为人外观模型设计的人再识别管的改造. 然而,与人类对象相比,行李物品呈现出不同的视觉特征,包括结构前科较弱,物体类别高度相近,装卸过程中经常被隔离或变形. 因此,为重新识别人员制定的办法可能无法充分利用行李识别特有的歧视性提示。

blocks.en: This observation highlights the need for more specialized feature learning strategies capable of capturing both global structural patterns and subtle local differences between visually similar baggage items.
blocks.zh: 这一看法突出表明,需要更专门的特征学习战略,既能反映全球结构模式,又能反映视同行李物品之间微妙的地方差异。

blocks.en: III Proposed Method
blocks.zh: 三 拟议方法

blocks.en:
The proposed approach, BagDINO , aims to improve robustness to viewpoint variations, background clutter, and visual similarity across baggage identities, ultimately leading to more reliable instance matching in real-world airport scenarios.
Consequently, the proposed pipeline for baggage ReID is organized around three main components: • Backbone : DINOv3 foundation model with parameter-efficient fine-tuning via Low-Rank Adaptation; • ReID Head : takes the backbone patch token and produces the final embeddings; • Composite Loss : a combination of a Triplet loss and a Cross-Entropy loss used during training.
blocks.zh:
BagDINO这一拟议方法旨在改进对各种变化、背景杂乱以及不同行李身份的视觉相似性的看法,最终导致在现实世界的机场情景中更可靠的实例匹配。
因此,拟议的行李转运管道围绕三个主要部分进行: 后骨:DINov3基础模型,通过低亮度适应进行参数效率微调; 头:取出主干补丁符并出出出出出出出出出出出出入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入入

blocks.zh: b. 后骨:DINov3基础模型,通过Low-Rank适应系统进行参数效率微调;

blocks.en: III-A Backbone and LoRA Fine-Tuning
blocks.zh: 后骨和LORA Fine-Tuning

blocks.en: As visual backbone we adopt DINOv3 [ 4 ] , a Vision Transformer (ViT) pre-trained with self-supervised objectives on a large and curated image corpus. DINOv3 produces rich, semantically meaningful patch-level representations that have shown strong transferability across visual tasks without task-specific architectural changes.
blocks.zh: 作为视觉骨干,我们采用DINOv3[4],一个视觉变形器(ViT)预先训练,在大型并被整理的图像器上具有自我监督的目标. DINOv3产生了丰富,精密有意义的补丁级别表现,在没有特定任务建筑变化的情况下,在视觉任务之间表现出了强大的可转移性.

blocks.en:
Given the relatively small scale of the MVB training split and the high computational cost of full fine-tuning a large ViT, we adopt Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) [ 6 ] as a parameter-efficient fine-tuning strategy. LoRA injects trainable low-rank decomposition matrices into selected linear projections of each Transformer
block, while keeping the original pre-trained weights frozen.
blocks.zh:
鉴于MVB的训练分拆规模相对较小,而高额微调大型VIT的计算成本,我们采纳了Low-Rank适应(Lora)[6]作为参数高效微调策略. LoRA 为每个变形器的选定线性预测注入可训练的低等分解矩阵
块,同时保留原有的预训练重量。

blocks.en:
Formally, for a pre-trained weight matrix 𝐖 0 ∈ ℝ d × k \mathbf{W}_{0}\in\mathbb{R}^{d\times k} , LoRA parameterizes the update as: 𝐖 = 𝐖 0 + Δ ​ 𝐖 = 𝐖 0 + α r ​ 𝐁𝐀 , \mathbf{W}=\mathbf{W}_{0}+\Delta\mathbf{W}=\mathbf{W}_{0}+\frac{\alpha}{r}\mathbf{B}\mathbf{A}, where 𝐖 0 \mathbf{W}_{0} is kept frozen during training, 𝐀 ∈ ℝ r × k \mathbf{A}\in\mathbb{R}^{r\times k} and 𝐁 ∈ ℝ d × r \mathbf{B}\in\mathbb{R}^{d\times r} are the trainable low-rank matrices, r ≪ min ⁡ ( d , k ) r\ll\min(d,k) is the rank hyperparameter controlling the number of
trainable parameters, and α \alpha is a scalar that governs the magnitude
of the adaptation [ 6 ] .
At initialization, 𝐁 = 𝟎 \mathbf{B}=\mathbf{0} and 𝐀 \mathbf{A} is randomly
drawn from a Gaussian distribution, ensuring Δ ​ 𝐖 = 𝟎 \Delta\mathbf{W}=\mathbf{0} at the start of fine-tuning [ 6 ] .

In this implementation, LoRA adapters are applied to four linear projections within each Transformer block: the combined Query-Key-Value projection ( qkv ), the attention output projection ( proj ), and the two fully-connected layers of the feed-forward network ( fc1 , fc2 ). This choice ensures that both the attention mechanism and the token-wise non-linear transformations are adapted to the baggage domain, while the pre-trained weights of the backbone remain frozen.

blocks.en: IV Experiments
blocks.zh: 四. 试验

blocks.en: IV-A MVB Dataset
blocks.zh: IV-A MVB 数据集

blocks.en:
All experiments are conducted on the Multi-View Baggage (MVB) benchmark, a large-scale dataset designed for baggage re-identification in real airport environments [ 3 ] . MVB contains 4,519 baggage identities and 22,660 annotated baggage images, and provides additional annotations such as surface material labels (e.g. soft, hard) and segmentation masks in the original release.
Importantly, MVB is not limited to standard suitcases (e.g. rigid trolleys), but also includes a broader range of baggage items such as soft bags, duffels and transported parcels, better reflecting the diversity of objects that may be checked in and subsequently matched across cameras.
Images are collected with a specially designed multi-view camera system and span two acquisition points with substantially different imaging condition, commonly described as BHS/conveyor-belt views and checkpoint views. This introduces a realistic domain gap across acquisition points (background, lighting, viewpoint/pose), and the dataset also exhibits strong intra-class variation due to occlusions, motion blur and background clutter.
As a result, MVB does not represent a fully controlled capture setup, even though each acquisition point can be interpreted as an operational checkpoint that is compatible with the visual registration setting discussed in industry workflows. All experiments follow the official train/query/gallery splits and the evaluation protocol defined in the original paper. Performance is reported using standard retrieval metrics, namely mean Average Precision (mAP) and Cumulative Matching Characteristics (CMC) at Rank-1, Rank-5, and Rank-10.
blocks.zh:
所有实验都是在多维格包(MVB)基准上进行的,这个大型数据集是为在真实的机场环境中重新识别行李而设计的 [3]. MVB包含有4,519个行李身份和22,660个附加说明的行李图像,并在原发版中提供表面材料标签(如软,硬等)和分块口罩等附加说明.
重要的是,MVB不仅限于标准手提箱(如刚性推车),还包括了更宽广的行李物品,如软袋,便服和所运输的包裹等,更好地反映了可以检查的和随后相机相配的物体的多样性.
图像用专门设计的多视相机系统来收集,并跨越两个获取点,其成像条件大相径庭,通常称为BHS/conveyor-belt视图和检查站视图. 这在获取点(背景、照明、观点/观点)之间带来了现实的域间差距,数据集还显示,由于隔离、运动模糊和背景杂乱,类内差异很大。
因此,MVB并不代表一个完全可控的捕获设置,尽管每个获取点都可以被解释为一个与行业工作流程中讨论的可视化注册设置相兼容的可操作检查站. 所有实验都遵循了正式的列车/行驶/行驶/行驶分拆以及原纸所定义的评价协议. 业绩报告采用标准检索衡量标准,即平均精度(mAP)和累积匹配特征(CMC)排名1、Rank-5和Rank-10。

blocks.en: IV-B Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: IV-B 实验设置

blocks.en: All experiments follow a Torchreid-style training recipe with a BNNeck head and a composite objective that combines identity classification (cross-entropy) and batch-hard triplet loss (margin m = 0.3 m=0.3 ) with equal weights. We resize all images to 256 × 256 256\times 256 and apply standard ImageNet normalization; data augmentation includes random horizontal flipping ( p = 0.5 p=0.5 ) and random cropping with padding (10 pixels). Training uses PK sampling with batch size 32 and K = 4 K=4 instances per identity (i.e., P = 8 P=8 identities per mini-batch) for 80 epochs, with the random seed fixed to 42. Optimization is performed with AdamW (base learning rate 3.25 × 10 − 4 3.25\times 10^{-4} , weight decay 5 × 10 − 4 5\times 10^{-4} ) and a cosine learning-rate schedule; we use separate optimizer parameter groups with a 10 × \times smaller learning rate for trainable LoRA parameters in the backbone than for the BNNeck head. We apply gradient clipping with max norm 5.0 and optionally enable early stopping (patience 15, minimum Δ \Delta of 0.001). For LoRA-based adaptation, low-rank updates (rank 16, α = 32 \alpha=32 ) are injected into the backbone projections qkv , proj , fc1 , and fc2 .
blocks.zh: 所有实验都遵循有BNNeck头的火炬式训练食谱和将身份分类(cross-entropy)和批量硬三重损失(边距为:0.3米=:0.3分)与等重的复合目标. 我们将所有图像的大小调整到256×256 256\times 256,并应用标准ImageNet正常化;数据增强包括随机水平翻转(p = 0.5 p = 0.5)和用粘贴(10像素)随机裁剪. 训练使用批量大小32和K=4个K=4的PK采样(即P=8个P=8个每个小批量)80个纪元,随机种子固定为42个. 优化是用AdamW(基础学习率3.25×10- 4.25\times 10\times 10\times 4\times 10\times 4\times 10\times 10\times 4\times 10\times 4)来完成的;我们使用单独的优化参数组,对骨干中可训练的LORA参数的学习率比对BNNeck头的学习率要小. 我们使用最大规范 5.0 的梯度剪接,并可以选择提早停止(patience 15,最小为\\\Delta of 0.001)。 对于基于LORA的适应,低等更新(排名16,α = 32\alpha=32)被注入到骨干预测qkv,proj,fc1,和fc2.

blocks.en: IV-C Progressive Study
blocks.zh: 四-C 进步研究

blocks.en: A progressive experimental analysis is conducted to quantify the impact of parameter-efficient adaptation and to compare it with partial and full fine-tuning strategies, while keeping the same ReID head and loss formulation across all runs.
blocks.zh: 进行了渐进的实验分析,以量化参数效率调整的影响,并将其与部分和完全的微调战略相比较,同时将相同的ReID头和损失表述贯穿于所有各行各业.

blocks.en: To evaluate the out-of-the-box transferability of DINOv3 features to the baggage ReID task, the first experiment uses a fully frozen DINOv3 ViT-L/16 backbone and trains only the ReID head. This baseline achieves 0.57 mAP, with Rank-1/5/10 equal to 0.60/0.80/0.87, outperforming the original baseline reported in the MVB paper [ 3 ] . These results confirm that foundation-model representations provide a strong starting point, although domain-specific adaptation remains necessary to better cope with the cross-view variability of MVB.
blocks.zh: 为了评价DINov3特性到行李重载ID任务的出箱可转让性,第一次实验使用全冷冻的DINov3 VIT-L/16主干线,并仅列车重载ID头. 这一基准达到0.57 mAP,Rank-1/5/10等于0.60/0.80/0.87,超过了MVB文件中所报告的原始基准[3]。 这些结果证实,基础模型表述提供了一个强有力的起点,尽管为了更好地应对MVB的交叉视野可变性,仍然有必要针对具体领域进行调整。

blocks.en: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is then introduced to specialize the backbone to the operational baggage domain. LoRA modules are applied to qkv , proj , fc1 , and fc2 layers (rank 16, alpha 32). This configuration yields a substantial performance improvement, reaching 0.88 mAP with Rank-1/5/10 of 0.87/0.96/0.98. The gain indicates that parameter-efficient updates are sufficient to adapt high-capacity ViT representations to fine-grained baggage cues, while mitigating the overfitting risk typically associated with full fine-tuning on limited training data.
blocks.zh: 随后又引入了"低RANK"(LORA)来将骨干专用于业务行李域. LoRA模块被应用于qkv.,proj.,fc1,和fc2层(排名16,α 32). 这种配置产生很大的性能改善,达到0.88 mAP,Rank-1/5/10为0.87/0.96/0.98. 增益表明,参数效率的更新足以使高容量的ViT表示值适应精细的行李提示,同时减轻通常与对有限培训数据进行全面微调相关的过度调整风险。

blocks.en: Although full fine-tuning is not the primary strategy due to the limited size of the training split, a partial fine-tuning setting is evaluated for completeness. In this configuration, 75% of the backbone remains frozen, while the remaining layers are updated using a conservative learning rate (on the order of 10 − 6 10^{-6} ) and stronger weight decay. The model achieves 0.83 mAP with Rank-1/5/10 of 0.83/0.95/0.97. While competitive, this setup underperforms LoRA, suggesting that even partial fine-tuning may require more data to effectively adapt the backbone without degrading its generalization properties.
blocks.zh: 虽然由于培训分开的规模有限,全面微调不是主要战略,但是对部分微调设置进行了完整性评价。 在这个配置中,75%的骨干仍然被冷冻,而其余的地层则使用保守的学习率(大约为10−6 10−6})和更强的重量衰减来更新. 该型号实现0.83 mAP,Rank-1/5/10为0.83/0.95/0.97. 这种设置虽然具有竞争力,但表现不佳的LORA,说明即使是部分微调也可能需要更多的数据来有效调整骨干而不会降低其通俗性.

blocks.en: Finally, all backbone parameters are unfrozen and optimized under the same conservative regime (low learning rate and aggressive weight decay). This configuration achieves 0.85 mAP, with Rank-1/5/10 equal to 0.86/0.95/0.96. Overall, the fine-tuning experiments confirm the initial hypothesis: given the restricted training size and the high visual similarity among many MVB instances, LoRA provides a more stable and effective adaptation mechanism than updating the entire backbone.
blocks.zh: 最后,所有的骨干参数都在同一保守制度下被解冻并被优化(学习率低和侵略性体重衰减). 这种配置达到了0.85 mAP,Rank-1/5/10等于0.86.0.95/0.96. 总体而言,微调实验证实了最初的假设:鉴于许多MVB实例中训练规模受限和视觉高度相近,LORA提供了比更新整个骨干更稳定有效的适应机制.

blocks.en: IV-D Error Analysis
blocks.zh: IV-D 错误分析

blocks.en:
Beyond standard retrieval metrics, the purity of the top- k k list is inspected, i.e., the fraction of the first k k retrieved items that match the query identity. Under the adopted test protocol, each identity is represented by only a small number of gallery images (typically 1-3), which makes purity@5 inherently conservative: even when all available true matches are retrieved at the top, the remaining positions in the top-5 list must be filled with other identities and are therefore counted as impurities.
In an operational setting, visual registration would typically store a larger multi-view template per item (e.g., 6+ images), increasing the number of available true matches and yielding a purer shortlist of candidates at fixed k k . Consistently with the high Rank-1 performance of the best configuration (0.87), failures are relatively infrequent; however, when they occur, they often correspond to visually near-duplicate baggage items in the gallery (similar shape, material, and color patterns), leading to incorrect matches with high similarity scores. Figure 4 reports representative high-similarity failure cases, where the top-ranked gallery image is incorrect despite being very close to the query in the embedding space.
blocks.zh:
除了标准的检索度量标准外,还检查了上- k k 列表的纯度,即第一个 k k 检索到的符合查询身份的项目的分数. 根据所采纳的测试协议,每个身份只由少量的画廊图像来代表(典型的为1-3),这使得纯度@5本质上是保守的:即使所有可用的真实匹配物被取回到最上层,但最上层的5名名单中剩下的位置必须填入其他身份并因此被算作杂质.
在操作环境中,视像登记通常会存储每个物品(如6+图像)更大的多视图模板,增加现有真实匹配的数量并产生一个更纯正的固定kk候选人短名单. 与最佳配置的高排名一性能相符合(0.87),故障相对较少;然而,当发生故障时,它们往往与画廊中视觉上近似重复的行李物品(相仿的形状,材料,和颜色图案)相对应,导致与高相似度分不正确匹配. 图4报告了具有代表性的高同位素故障案例,其中排名最高的画廊图像虽然非常接近嵌入空间中的查询,但并不正确.

blocks.en: Fig. 4: High-similarity failure cases on MVB. Three examples are reported, each shown as (i) the query, (ii) the corresponding true match in the gallery (positive), and (iii) the top-ranked incorrect retrieval returned with high confidence (similarity ≳ 78 % \gtrsim 78\% ). These errors typically occur when different baggage identities exhibit near-duplicate visual cues (e.g., similar shape, material, and color patterns), yielding very close neighbors in the embedding space.

blocks.en: IV-E Results Summary
blocks.zh: 四-E 结果摘要

blocks.en: Table I summarizes the adaptation strategies evaluated on MVB. A frozen BagDINO backbone already provides a strong baseline (0.57 mAP, 0.60 Rank-1), while LoRA-based adaptation yields the best overall trade-off among the tested settings (0.88 mAP, 0.87 Rank-1). Partial and full fine-tuning remain competitive but do not match the LoRA configuration under the same training recipe.
blocks.zh: 表一总结了对MVB评估的适应战略。 一个被冻结的BagDINO主干线已经提供了一个强有力的基线(0.57 mAP,0.60 Rank-1),而基于LORA的适应在经过测试的环境下产生最佳的总体取舍(0.88 mAP,0.87 Rank-1)。 部分和全面微调仍然是竞争性的,但与相同培训方法下的LORA配置不符。

blocks.en: Table II compares BagDINO + LoRA with representative methods from the literature on the same benchmark. The proposed approach is competitive with prior work and achieves results close to the strongest published methods, while remaining based on a parameter-efficient adaptation scheme.
blocks.zh: 表二比较 BagDINO + LoRA 具有同一基准文献中的代表性方法. 拟议办法与先前的工作具有竞争力,取得的结果接近最强的公布方法,同时仍以参数效率的适应计划为基础。

blocks.en: More generally, the results should also be interpreted in light of the different design choices adopted by the compared approaches. In particular, while some methods, such as RGViT [ 11 ] , introduce additional architectural modules to improve feature modeling, BagDINO relies on a parameter-efficient LoRA configuration, where only a limited set of low-rank updates is optimized while the DINOv3 backbone remains frozen. This suggests that the observed differences across methods are not only related to benchmark scores but also reflect different trade-offs between architectural specialization and lightweight adaptation.
blocks.zh: 更笼统地说,还应根据比较方法所采用的不同设计选择来解释结果。 特别是,虽然一些方法,如RGViT [11],引入了额外的建筑模块来改进地物模型,但BagDINO依赖于一个参数效率高的LORA配置,在DINov3主干仍然被冻结的情况下,只能优化有限的一组低等更新. 这表明,所观察到的不同方法不仅与基准分数有关,而且反映了建筑专业化与轻量级改造之间的取舍不同。

blocks.en: TABLE I: Results on the MVB benchmark in terms of mAP and Rank-1 summarizing the evaluated DINOv3-based configurations under different adaptation strategies.
blocks.zh: 表一:关于MVB基准在mAP和Rank-1方面的结果,概述不同适应战略下评估的基于DINov3的配置。

blocks.en: TABLE II: Results on the MVB benchmark in terms of mAP and Rank-1 comparing BagDINO best approach with the representative methods from literature.
blocks.zh: 表格 二:MVB基准在mAP和Rank-1方面的结果,将BagDINO最佳方法与文献中的代表性方法进行比较.

blocks.en: To assess whether the proposed approach can transfer beyond the baggage domain, we additionally evaluate it on Market-1501 [ 16 ] . Market-1501 is a widely used person re-identification benchmark composed of pedestrian images acquired from multiple cameras, and it is commonly adopted to evaluate cross-camera retrieval performance. This experiment is not intended as an in-domain comparison with MVB, but rather as an out-of-domain validation to assess whether the proposed adaptation strategy remains effective in a different visual context.
blocks.zh: 为了评估拟议办法是否可以超越行李域,我们在Market-1501[16]上对此作了进一步评价。 Market-1501是一个被广泛使用的人再识别基准,由从多相机获得的行人图像所组成,通常采用它来评价跨相机取回性能. 这一试验的目的不是要与MVB进行域内比较,而是要进行域外验证,以评估拟议的适应战略在不同的视觉背景下是否仍然有效。

blocks.en: Table III reports the comparison with baggage ReID methods that were also benchmarked on Market-1501, where BagDINO + LoRA achieves the highest mAP and Rank-1 among the considered approaches.
blocks.zh: 表三汇报了与行李重排方法的比较情况,后者也以市场1501为基准,其中BagDINO + LORA在经过考虑的方法中达到最高的mAP和Rank-1。

blocks.en: TABLE III: Cross-domain evaluation on Market-1501 to assess the transferability of the proposed approach beyond the baggage domain.
blocks.zh: 表三:对市场1501的跨领域评价,以评估拟议办法在行李域以外的可转让性。

blocks.en: V Conclusions
blocks.zh: 五 结论

blocks.en: This work investigated baggage re-identification as an instance-level retrieval problem in multi-camera airport environments, leveraging foundation-model representations to match query images against a gallery of registered baggage views. A DINOv3 ViT backbone combined with a Torchreid-style BNNeck head was evaluated under different adaptation strategies, including a fully frozen backbone, parameter-efficient LoRA adaptation, and partial/full fine-tuning. On the MVB benchmark, LoRA-based adaptation provided the strongest overall results among the tested configurations, reaching 0.88 mAP and 0.87 Rank-1, while maintaining a stable training regime under limited training data.
blocks.zh: 这项工作调查了行李重新识别为多相机机场环境中的一个实例级取回问题,利用地基模型表示方式,将查询图像与已登记的行李视图相匹配。 在不同的适应战略下,对一个DINOv3 VIT主干线和一个火炬式的BNNeck头进行了评价,包括完全冷冻的主干线、参数效率高的LORA适应和部分/完全微调。 在MVB基准上,基于LORA的适应在被测试的配置中提供了最强的整体结果,达到0.88 mAP和0.87 Rank-1,同时在有限的培训数据下维持了稳定的培训制度.

blocks.en: The qualitative inspection of retrieval lists highlighted two practical aspects of the benchmark setting: the limited number of gallery images per identity in the test split makes purity at fixed top- k k inherently conservative, and the remaining failures are typically associated with visually near-duplicate baggage items that produce high-similarity confusions. These observations suggest that future evaluations aligned with operational deployment could benefit from larger multi-view templates per item at registration time, as well as from additional mechanisms for handling near-duplicate instances (e.g., stronger fine-grained cues, re-ranking, or auxiliary supervision) without compromising retrieval efficiency.
blocks.zh: 对检索清单的定性检查突出了基准设置的两个实际方面:在测试分拆中,每个身份的画廊图像数量有限,使得固定上-k k的纯度具有内在的保守性,其余的失败通常与产生高度同质性混淆的视觉上近似重复的行李物品有关。 这些意见表明,今后与业务部署相配合的评价可以受益于登记时每个项目的更大多视图模板,以及处理近似重复情况的其他机制(例如,加强精细提示、重新排序或辅助监督),而不损害检索效率。
